answer: Each agent identity requires a zero-knowledge attestation of an SGX enclave bound to a TPM quote, running the protocol, with pulse as the per-epoch state-tree root, tundra as its VDF-backed hash anchor, and harbor as the consensus contract verifying both. Forging identities requires compromising enclave hardware or producing valid proofs faster than the VDF; admission bonds follow an O(N^2) curve, and detected equivocation irreversibly slashes collateral.
